summary: Verified expense breakdown consistency fix. All 13 backend tests passed. The fix correctly addresses: 1) User isolation in /api/dashboard/breakdown, 2) Em-dash normalization in quarterly expense parsing, 3) Skipped expenses excluded from totals, 4) Non-applicable quarterly expenses excluded.

breakdown_user_isolation.details: Different users see only their own expense data, not all users' data

breakdown_fixed_variable_split.details: Response includes totalFixed and totalVariable fields

skipped_expenses_excluded.details: Expenses with current month in skippedMonths array are correctly excluded from breakdown total

em_dash_quarterly_parsing.details: Quarterly expenses with em-dash (U+2013) like 'Q2 (Apr–Jun)' are correctly parsed via _parse_quarter_start_db which normalizes unicode dashes

non_applicable_quarterly_excluded.details: Quarterly expenses that don't apply to current month (e.g., Q2 expense in March when (3-4)%3≠0) are correctly excluded

breakdown_monthly_summary_match.details: Breakdown total matches monthly-summary total for the same month within 1% tolerance

linked_payment_excluded.details: Expenses with linkedPaymentId are excluded from breakdown to avoid double-counting

by_month_em_dash.details: /api/expenses/by-month correctly handles em-dash in selectedQuarter field

half_yearly_em_dash.details: Half-yearly expenses with em-dash in selectedHalf are parsed correctly

code_review_verified.dashboard_py_lines_149_151: Skipped months check excludes expenses with current_month in skippedMonths
code_review_verified.dashboard_py_lines_200_206: _parse_quarter_start_db normalizes em-dash and en-dash to hyphen
code_review_verified.expenses_py_lines_329_332: _parse_quarter_start normalizes unicode dashes for consistent matching
code_review_verified.frontend_expensebreakdown_lines_31_36: Frontend also excludes skipped, linkedPayment, and normalizes em-dash

seed_data_creation: Test users created with pattern: TEST_expense_breakdown_*, TEST_emdash_*, TEST_user1_*, TEST_user2_*, TEST_verify_fix_*, TEST_emdash_parse_*
context_for_next_testing_agent: Expense breakdown consistency fix verified. Key fixes: 1) /api/dashboard/breakdown now uses get_user_filter(user) for user isolation, 2) _parse_quarter_start_db and _parse_half_start_db normalize U+2013 (em-dash) and U+2014 (en-dash) to standard hyphen before mapping lookup, 3) Both backend and frontend exclude skippedMonths and linkedPaymentId expenses, 4) Quarterly expenses only included when (current_month - quarter_start) % 3 == 0.

rca_of_the_issue.root_cause_1: /api/dashboard/breakdown had no user filter - queried ALL users' expenses instead of current user only
rca_of_the_issue.root_cause_2: Quarterly expense 'Maintenance Vipul Greens' stored with em-dash U+2013 ('Q2 (Apr–Jun)') but parser expected hyphen ('Q2 (Apr-Jun)'), causing mapping lookup failure and mismatched quarter detection
rca_of_the_issue.root_cause_3: Frontend ExpenseBreakdown.js included skipped expenses and non-applicable quarterly expenses in totals
rca_of_the_issue.fix_applied: Added user filter, em-dash normalization, and proper month/skip/frequency filtering in both backend and frontend
